{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMWpgs8AAAABZfUeYQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnW-xzhDGfQs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnW-x", "number": 51, "title": "Honor live V9938 command-color register writes", "body": "## Problem

The V9938 command engine snapshots R44 into `Command.color` at command start (`crates/msx-core/src/vdp_command.rs:77`). Subsequent writes reach `command_write`, which only accepts LMMC/HMMC transfer data. Active drawing and search therefore continue using stale color despite the visible register changing.

Real V9938 measurements demonstrate changing colors during an executing LINE. This is an incorrect shared MSX2 hardware behavior affecting software that updates command color while CE is set. No particular commercial-game failure is established.

## Expected outcome

Honor R44 writes during active commands that consume color: PSET, LINE, LMMV, HMMV and SRCH. Previously completed work retains its result; subsequent modeled work consumes the updated value without restarting the command. Preserve pixel-color masking, HMMV’s full packed byte and existing transfer protocols.

Deliver the smallest complete correction with native, CPU/Wasm integration and documentation changes. Exact VRAM arbitration, access-phase synchronization, command speeds and SRCH comparison-mask/EQ/expansion ambiguities remain separate work.

## Context

- Evaluation baseline: `3bdf49f4ef1a8c8ace906d340298b34c27250e7a`; clean local HEAD matches inspected GitHub main. The open Issue/PR collection is empty. [Issue #45](https://github.com/takahirox/msx-rust/issues/45) and its completed boundary work explicitly deferred live color writes.
- Relevant paths: `crates/msx-core/src/vdp_command.rs`, `Vdp::set_register`/`write_indirect` in `vdp.rs`, and instruction-level device scheduling in `lib.rs`. Existing coverage includes `crates/msx-core/tests/msx2.rs`, `vdp_command_edges.rs` and `tests/msx2.spec.js`; inspected tests do not cover live drawing-color changes.
- [Physical V9938 measurements](https://openmsx.org/vdp-vram-timing/vdp-timing.html), Introduction, describe rapidly changing the color register during LINE execution on real hardware. The measured machine is a Philips NMS8250.
- The [Yamaha V9938 manual](https://www.dinoboards.com.au/assets/video-v9958/yamaha_v9938.pdf), printed pages 1, 64–65 and 74–77, defines direct/indirect register access and drawing color/byte formats. The live-write behavior is established by the experiment and corroborated by upstream, rather than assumed from the manual’s setup instructions.
- The [pinned openMSX command engine](https://github.com/openMSX/openMSX/blob/26e1e4945df406e250a05122889f88d40edd828b/src/video/VDPCmdEngine.cc) synchronizes before updating COL in `setCmdReg`; PSET, LINE, LMMV, HMMV and SRCH consume that state. Its transfer/TR comments retain uncertainty. Use this as behavioral evidence and independently author implementation and fixtures.
- [PR #50](https://github.com/takahirox/msx-rust/pull/50) reports 198 Rust and 110 browser passes and completed local self-review. Inspected [CI step metadata](https://github.com/takahirox/msx-rust/actions/runs/40021065651/job/120645444319) records successful checks. These results do not validate this missing behavior. No builds or tests were run for this investigation.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Update active color consumption through both direct port 99h writes and indirect port 9Bh writes using R17. Preserve command position, accumulated work, completion registers and CE. Color updates must not restart commands or create persistent transfer requests for drawing commands.
- [ ] Add independent native vectors across SCREEN 5–8 for LINE, LMMV and HMMV. Include multiple color changes, partial tick budgets, packed-pixel neighbors, logical/transparent operations and unchanged surrounding VRAM. HMMV must retain all eight color bits. Check exact bytes/pixels and bounded completion.
- [ ] Include this fixed SCREEN 5 vector under the existing eight-T-state work model: draw horizontal LINE from (0,0), NX=7, NY=0, color 1; advance 24 T-states; write R44=2; finish. Pixels 0–2 remain 1 and pixels 3–7 become 2, producing bytes `11 12 22 22`. Equal elapsed budgets partitioned differently around the same write timestamps must agree.
- [ ] Cover PSET updated before its first work unit and an active SRCH updated before a subsequent comparison. Use in-range SRCH colors and the existing EQ contract; do not fold the separate comparison-mask correction into this Issue. Writes after completion must not alter completed VRAM; subsequent commands use the latest register value.
- [ ] Retain LMMC/HMMC initial-data and TR-gated transfer behavior, LMCM/S7 reads, deliberate stalls, final-transfer completion, STOP/replacement/reset, reverse-Y termination and interleaving regressions. Updating shared color state must not overwrite already accepted pending data or duplicate transfers. Document remaining transient-TR uncertainty.
- [ ] Add an original CPU-executed probe that changes R44 through direct and indirect ports while a sufficiently long drawing command is active. Assert independently expected old/new-color regions and completion. Exercise the result through compiled-Wasm Canvas checks at `/` and `/msx-rust/`, retaining reset and existing diagnostic coverage. Document the current instruction-level timing boundary without requiring a scheduler redesign.
- [ ] Preserve MSX1/MSX2 firmware/slots, PSG/SCC/SCC-I audio, disk, SRAM persistence, Wasm/browser lifecycle and ownership/provenance safeguards. Update affected accuracy documentation and any changed fixture inventory/provenance. Require no proprietary ROM acquisition or human gameplay.
- [ ] The Coordinator records representative baseline-failing regressions and corrected passes, then runs the README checks before merge: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `./scripts/build.sh`, `node scripts/check-dist.mjs`, `npm test` and `git diff --check`, with documented dependency setup as needed. Complete source-Issue/full-diff review under `docs/review-guidelines.md`, resolve blocking findings and distinguish passed, failed, skipped and unperformed checks.

## Optional validation

Before merge, compare the independently authored live-color probe against the pinned upstream emulator, recording configuration and observations. This comparison was not performed and is not required for acceptance. Exact physical transition timing and commercial-title compatibility remain unestablished.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
